title: mcring AskRequest (multipart form fields)
description: POST /v1/ask is multipart/form-data: an `image` file part (JPEG/PNG), an optional `audio` part (IMA-ADPCM or WAV voice question), and these text fields.

question.description: Free-text question about the image. Empty = use the mode's default question.

session_id.description: Opaque id; lets follow-up questions refer to the previous image.

want_speech.description: Ask the server to synthesize speech (phone-side TTS is the default).
